_comment: Round 2 = round 1 + (a) tiered per-person price for multi-name orders (persons 1-5 full, 6-10 at 90%, 11+ at 80%) as candidate quantities persons_eff and persons_eff*quantity, (b) no lead-time threshold flags (rush is signalled by the remark), (c) no automatic products of numeric columns (quantity*total_qty etc. have no pricing meaning), (d) two extra search variants that start from the base fee (forward selection). The engine keeps a term only if more quotes reproduce to the yen.

derived.a4eq: quantity * kinds * if_(size == 'A3', 2, if_(size == 'B4', 1.5, if_(size == 'B5', 0.75, if_(size == 'A5', 0.5, 1))))
derived.sheets: ceil(quantity / if_(size == 'A3', 4, if_(size == 'A4', 8, if_(size == 'B4', 8, if_(size == 'A5', 16, if_(size == 'B5', 16, 1)))))) * kinds
